messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Common prednisone side effects:
The most common prednisone side effects are trouble sleeping, mood changes, increased appetite and weight gain, fluid retention and swelling, increased sweating, acne, thinning skin that bruises easily, slow wound healing, higher blood sugar, indigestion and stomach upset.
Many of these effects are dose related. They are more likely on higher doses and on longer courses, and most settle after the medicine is stopped.
Serious prednisone side effects:
Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to prednisone: hives, difficult breathing, or swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
- signs of infection, such as fever, chills, sore throat, cough or a wound that is not healing, since prednisone can hide the usual warning signs;
- blurred vision, eye pain or seeing halos around lights, which can be signs of glaucoma (raised pressure in the eye) or cataracts;
Triplet: ["prednisone", "side effects resolve after", "stopping the medicine"]

The relation 'side effects resolve after' in the triplet is defined as 'The side effects associated with the subject drug typically subside following discontinuation of the medication.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may cause weight regain after discontinuation': Stopping the use of the subject drug may lead to a return of weight.
B. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
C. 'has discontinuation rate': A specified percentage of patients discontinue use of the subject drug as indicated by the object entity.
D. 'has withdrawal symptom': When the subject drug is stopped abruptly, the patient may experience the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
